paragraphs: Rabbah bar Yonatan said that R' Yehiel said (see just above). Heilprin cites Nedarim 41b with “Rava bar Yonatan.” The checked Bavli reads “Rabbah bar Yonatan said in Rav Yehiel’s name.”
